title: The Prestige Trap
hook: Your "dream company" is actually a luxury tax on your freedom.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side—Corporate logo/glitzy office. Right side—A person staring at a screen at 11 PM). 
Voiceover: Most Indian professionals spend their 20s chasing a brand name on their LinkedIn profile. We call it "prestige." But let’s apply first principles. 
(Visual: Text overlay—Prestige = Social Signaling). 
What you're actually doing is trading your hourly rate for a social signal. You accept lower pay, longer hours, and zero autonomy because the logo on your business card makes your relatives proud. 
(Visual: Graph showing "Market Value" vs "Brand Ego"). 
The market doesn't pay for prestige; it pays for rare and valuable skills. If the only reason you stay in a toxic role is the "brand name," you aren't building a career—you're paying a subscription fee to feel important. 
Stop optimizing for how your resume looks to others, and start optimizing for how your life feels to you.
caption: We are taught to chase the logo, not the leverage. Prestige is a lagging indicator of success, but chasing it is a leading indicator of burnout. Are you building a career, or just a trophy for your parents? #RationalThoughts #CareerStrategy #FirstPrinciples #CorporateLife India
